主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. requested stockholders to elect two Class III supervisory directors for a term expiring at the 2015 Annual Meeting. The Company also sought ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers as independent registered public accountants for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2012. Additional proposals included non-binding advisory votes on executive compensation and the frequency of such votes, approval of Dutch Statutory Annual Accounts in English, cancellation of repurchased shares, extension of repurchase authority up to 10% of issued share capital until November 16, 2013, and extension of authority to issue shares and grant rights up to 20% of outstanding shares per annum until May 16, 2017. The Company also requested approval of amendments to its articles of association in connection with listing on NYSE Euronext in Amsterdam. The amendments were approved on May 22, 2012, with 38,304,176 votes in favor, 26,868 against, 13,735 abstentions, and 2,928,771 broker non-votes.
